cross_mesh_initialization_comparison.comparison_basis: Each mesh's own native t=0; no cross-mesh time interpolation.

definitions.Vg: sum over the native tankZone of (1-alpha.water)*cellVolume.
definitions.configured_e_s: For current hConst + perfectGas + sensibleInternalEnergy, source chain gives Es = Hs - p/rho = Cv*T - Cp*Tref + Href. Tref defaults to Tstd=298.15 K, Href defaults 0; Hf=0 is present but sensible Es uses Hs (Hf is excluded).
definitions.gas_mass: sum (1-alpha.water)*p/(R_OpenFOAM*T.air)*cellVolume; R from exact v2512 source audit.
definitions.normalization: Each case/tank is normalized against its own native cold t=0; mesh initial capacities are not forced equal and times are not interpolated to a common grid.
definitions.p_dV: Trapezoidal integral of pbar against successive saved native Vg, no interpolation; positive for expansion under the declared sign convention.
definitions.pressure: pbar = sum(alpha_g*p*V)/Vg over the native tankZone. p05/p50/p95/min/max use positive alpha_g*V volume weights only; negative signed excursions are separately reported.
definitions.proxy_remainder: delta(U_g*) + integral(pbar dVg); the configured-e_s version additionally carries the exact gas-mass reference correction. Nonuniformity, phase-interface transport, open-boundary flux and other terms remain unresolved.
definitions.quadrature_sensitivity: Compare all saved snapshots against every-other-snapshot trapezoids while retaining both endpoints.
definitions.raw_gas_fraction: alpha_g = 1 - alpha.water; no clipping. Signed integrals retain alpha excursions outside [0,1].

native_endpoint_comparison.qualification: Endpoints are the last available safe complete native snapshots in each run; their times differ and are not interpolated.

objective: Native gas EOS/internal-energy stores and trapezoidal tank gas-volume-weighted p dV proxy for the 299248-cell corrected wet48 baseline to .4000867 s and all safe complete 456954-cell refined cold-start snapshots through current guard time.
qualification: The reported delta(U_g*) + integral(pbar dVg) is only a uniform-headspace work proxy remainder. It is not heat transfer, a closed CFD energy balance, or proof of a numerical energy defect. The two endpoint remainders occur at different times/expansion ratios and cannot be compared directly as a mesh-error reduction. Whole-domain gas inventory change is not a gas conservation defect.

T.air.interpretation: Mapped internal-cell fields only; native file hashes also include patch/boundary representation.

T.water.interpretation: Mapped internal-cell fields only; native file hashes also include patch/boundary representation.

seam_check.series_selection: Refined t0 through .135021166664 uses continuation-attempt2; later states use continuation-attempt5. This seam is a resource-save restart, and any byte differences are retained rather than normalized away.

publication_transform.meaning: Mass-drift quantities are inventory changes from native t0, not conservation residuals. The whole domain is open and vents air; its inventory loss must be distinguished from boundary-flux-balanced conservation error. All numerical values are unchanged.
